description: Add a field to a database. select/multi_select/workflow take options as labels; `workflow` is the type of the one lifecycle status field a database is tracked by (at most ONE; board grouping and My Work key off it), whereas `select` is an ordinary choice field. lookup/rollup/formula/ai need `config`; a formula can be checked with preview_formula, which saves nothing. Relations are not added here (create_relation adds them). Covers formula format and currency, rollup ops and filters, AI field prompt/output. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES add_field"]

options.description: select/multi_select/workflow choices, as labels or {label,color,icon,category}. On a workflow field each option gets a state category (inferred from its label and position unless you give one). Omit them on a workflow field to get To do / In progress / Done.

category.description: State category: backlog | unstarted | started | completed | canceled (completed and canceled mean finished). Workflow options only (and select options that say it); inferred from the label when omitted on a workflow.

icon.description: Curated icon ref: "set:<name>" or "brand:<slug>" (See also: get_started section "ICONS").

name: add_field
title: Add field
